title: Governance plane v2 — revive unlanded May improvements
description: Eight governor-suggested improvements from the unmerged May fleet branch, re-specced against current main. Source spec preserved as git tag archive/governance-plane-v2. Two branch items dropped as superseded (see architectureNotes).
architectureNotes:
Origin: unmerged fleet branch moe/work-2026-05-16, archived as git tag archive/governance-plane-v2 (commit 8077693). The branch's code is 2.5 months stale against main — treat it as a SPEC, not a merge source; re-implement each item against current main.

Deliberately dropped from this epic (superseded on main):
- Item #8 chat_wait keepalive heartbeat — the wrapper heartbeat sidecar (moe-agent.{sh,ps1}) now pings moe.heartbeat on a timer for ALL blocking waits.
- The branch's verificationEvidence min-length shape checks — superseded by structured complete_task verification {command, exitCode, outputTail} and required qa_approve summary (commit e651c22).
- read-before-act role-doc mandates — superseded by the runtime-driven workflow (nextAction + get_context enforcement).

Landed since the branch, interacts with this epic (do not regress): plan-size gate in submit_plan (settings.taskSizing, util/planSize.ts), required verification on complete_task, required summary on qa_approve, planSizeWarnings persistence, epic-final qualityGate in the wrappers.
epicRails: Re-implement against current main; the archived branch (tag archive/governance-plane-v2) is a spec, not a merge source
Every new settings key: ProjectSettings type + validateSettingsUpdate whitelist/validation + docs/SCHEMA.md + docs/CONFIGURATION.md
New MCP tools must be registered in getTools() in packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/index.ts or they are invisible
No tool handler may run long synchronous work under the state mutex; only blocking:true tools may park
Each task ships vitest coverage next to the files it touches; name the exact vitest command in the plan
